Using those chart_analyzer values, the average acceleration over the first 20 s is (10-0)/20 = 0.5 m/s², and the average acceleration over the first 30 s is (12-0)/30 = 0.4 m/s².
Adding the two computed accelerations gives 0.5 + 0.4 = 0.9 m/s².
So the tool-grounded result is 0.9 m/s², but 0.9 is not among the listed options A-E; the evidence therefore supports an option-set mismatch rather than any one provided choice.
